subject.title: feat(ui): gateway subtitle in the sidebar footer identity card

question: Should this Mac-only persistent gateway indicator land once real native-app proof verifies the injected snapshot and update event across saved profile switching?
rationale: The branch adds a user-visible capability and is protected by the `maintainer` label; mock-harness screenshots do not settle the native bridge lifecycle that users rely on.

options.title: Require native-app proof, then land
options.body: Add redacted Mac-app screenshots, recording, or runtime output for two saved gateways and a gateway-change update, then review the exact head for landing.

options.title: Keep the header picker as the only indicator
options.body: Decline this additional persistent footer surface if maintainers prefer the existing dashboard picker to remain the sole selected-gateway cue.

recommendation.title: Require native-app proof, then land
recommendation.body: Add redacted Mac-app screenshots, recording, or runtime output for two saved gateways and a gateway-change update, then review the exact head for landing.
